description: This file defines the UnseekableStreamException class within the Laminas\Diactoros\Exception namespace, providing specific exception subclasses for handling errors related to unseekable streams.

classes.name: UnseekableStreamException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating issues when a stream cannot be seeked.

methods.name: dueToConfiguration
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the stream is unseekable due to configuration issues.

methods.name: dueToMissingResource
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the stream lacks a resource for seeking.

methods.name: dueToPhpError
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating a PHP error occurred during stream seeking.

methods.name: forCallbackStream
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating callback streams cannot seek and thus are unseekable.
